## Description

Self-hosted IT documentation and service desk for MSPs. Client workspaces, assets, runbooks, an encrypted credential vault, native ticketing with SLAs, contracts and invoices, and the physical network drawn: racks, switch ports, cables. Multi-tenant, with Ctrl+K search across it all. Django 6 + MariaDB, Docker or one-line install.
